title: Baby Shower Board
seo_title: Baby Shower Charcuterie Board Plan & Shopping List (10–16)
description: A pregnancy-friendly baby shower board for 10–16: pasteurized Havarti, baby Gouda, herbed cream cheese, cooked prosciutto cotto, turkey, berries and macarons.
hook: A soft pastel board built on pasteurized cheeses and cooked meats, so it follows pregnancy food guidance without anyone reading labels.
why: Pregnancy guidance from the CDC is to avoid unpasteurized cheese and cold cured meats unless they're heated. This board follows it: pasteurized Havarti, baby Gouda, cheddar and cream cheese, with cooked prosciutto cotto and deli turkey. Serve deli meat heated until steaming if the mom-to-be wants to follow that advice strictly.
The pastel palette sets the mood: pink berries, pale yellow Havarti, white cream cheese and macarons, with cheddar cut into stars as the photo moment.

timeline.what: Take out the cheeses; set out the decorations.
Cut the cheddar stars; wash the fruit.
Place the cheeses; add the dips and honey.
Add the meats and berries; scatter the flowers.

faq.a: Cured meats and deli meats should be heated until steaming during pregnancy, and cheeses should be pasteurized. This board uses pasteurized cheeses and cooked meats.

faq.q: What cheese is safe for a baby shower?
faq.a: Pasteurized hard and semi-soft cheeses like Havarti, Gouda, cheddar and cream cheese. Avoid unpasteurized soft cheeses and check labels.

faq.q: How much food for a baby shower board?
faq.a: As the main food, about 2 to 3 oz each of cheese and meat per guest.
